```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../setup.R")
state_crosswalk <- read.csv("state_crosswalk.csv") %>%
  mutate(full_upper = str_to_upper(full)) %>%
  select(full_upper, abbr)
PRE_PET_CA <- read.csv("../Input/PET&PRE_Region_30y.csv")
PRE_PET_US <- read.csv(us_outputs("1.5_PET&PRE_State_30y.csv"))
PRE_PET <- rbind(PRE_PET_US, PRE_PET_CA)
```

## read all data

```{r all data}
# read & stack
N2OIEF <- list.files("../Output", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  # iterate over each file and bind rows as we go
  map_dfr(~ {
    file    <- .x
    raw_tbl <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # 1. harmonise key columns --------------------------------------------------
   clean_tbl <- raw_tbl %>%
   rename_with(~ "Region", any_of(c("Province", "ProvinceID", "Region"))) %>% 
   rename_with(~ "Crop",   any_of(c("Crop", "CropID")))

    # 2. add metadata -----------------------------------------------------------
    clean_tbl %>% 
      mutate(
        File      = basename(file),
        Country   = str_detect(File, "_Canada")   %>% if_else("Canada", "USA"),
        Pathway   = case_when(
          str_detect(File, "FSN")            ~ "Direct – FSN",
          str_detect(File, "Irrigation")     ~ "Direct – Irrigation",
          str_detect(File, "Volatilization") ~ "Indirect – Volatilisation",
          str_detect(File, "Leaching")       ~ "Indirect – Leaching",
          TRUE                               ~ "Unknown"
        )
      ) %>% 
      # 3. keep only what we need (Region, Crop, N2O.IEF + metadata)
      select(Region, Crop, Tot.Fert, Tot.N2O, N2O.IEF, Country, Pathway, File)
  }) %>%
  mutate(N2O.IEF = na_if(N2O.IEF,0)) %>%
  mutate(IsDirect = str_starts(Pathway, "Direct"))


#Join IEF and PRE, PET data
N2OIEF <- N2OIEF %>%
  left_join(PRE_PET, by = c("Region" = "REGION"))

#Using the State's abbreviations
N2OIEF <- N2OIEF %>%                              
  mutate(Region_upper = str_to_upper(Region)) %>%   
  left_join(state_crosswalk,                      
            by = c("Region_upper" = "full_upper")) %>% 
  mutate(Region = coalesce(abbr, Region)) %>%     
  select(-Region_upper, -abbr)                    

```


## Plot 

x and y are the precipitation and potential evapotranspiration in growing season. 

```{r Fig 1}
#Create table for direct emissions and regardless of crop. 
IEF_Region <- N2OIEF %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tot.Fert), Tot.Fert != 0) %>%
  group_by(Region, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    Sum_Fert       = sum(Tot.Fert, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sum_N2O        = sum(Tot.N2O,  na.rm = TRUE),
    GROW_PRE_wavg  = first(GROW_PRE_wavg),
    GROW_PET_wavg  = first(GROW_PET_wavg),
    IsDirect       = first(IsDirect),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Sum_IEF = Sum_N2O/Sum_Fert) %>%
  filter(IsDirect == TRUE)



library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, ggplot2, etc.
library(scatterpie)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)     # for draw_plot() – installs with ggplot2 3.4+
library(scales)


cloud <- list(
  xmin = 600, xmax = 850,   # PET range
  ymin = 500, ymax = 750    # PRE range
)

cloud_data <- pie_data %>%
  filter(x >= cloud$xmin, x <= cloud$xmax,
         y >= cloud$ymin, y <= cloud$ymax)

main_data  <- anti_join(pie_data, cloud_data, by = "Region")

scale_factor  <- 150
legend_factor <- 1
breaks_ief    <- c(0.002, 0.005, 0.009, 0.14)
#break_radii   <- sqrt(breaks_ief/pi) * scale_factor * legend_factor
break_radii   <- c(7.6,9.5,11.35,32)
labeller <- function(r){
  val <- (r / (scale_factor * legend_factor))^2 * pi
  comma(val, accuracy = 0.001)
}


p_main <- ggplot() +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data   = bind_rows(main_data, cloud_data),     # all pies
    aes(x = x, y = y, r = radius),
    cols   = c("Direct_FSN", "Direct_Irrigation"),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Pathway",
    values = c("Direct_FSN" = "#E34A33",
               "Direct_Irrigation" = "#3182BD")
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(                       # labels ONLY outside cloud
    data  = main_data,
    aes(x, y, label = Region),
    size        = 2.5,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding= 0.4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  geom_scatterpie_legend(                # size legend
    radius   = break_radii,
    #radius   = c(3.784699, 5.98, 8.0285, 31.665),
    x        = 1000,  y = 850,
    n        = length(break_radii),
    colour   = "grey20",
    labeller = labeller,
    #labeller = c(0.002,0.005,0.009,0.14),
    hjust    = -0.15,          # push text 15 % right of circle centre
    y_gap    = 1               # small vertical gap between circles
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 900, y = 750 + max(break_radii)*1.3,
           label = expression(IEF~(kg~N[2]*O-N/kg~N)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Weighted mean evapotranspiration (mm)",
    y = "Weighted mean precipitation (mm)",
    title = expression(Direct~N[2]*O~implied~emission~factors~`(IEF)`~by~region)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(0.97, 0.97),   # colour legend top-right
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", .8), colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank()
  )

p_inset <- ggplot() +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data   = cloud_data,
    aes(x, y, r = radius),
    cols   = c("Direct_FSN", "Direct_Irrigation"),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E34A33", "#3182BD"), guide = "none") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data  = cloud_data,
    aes(x, y, label = Region),
    size = 2, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(cloud$xmin, cloud$xmax),
              ylim = c(cloud$ymin, cloud$ymax), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(600, 700, 800)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(500, 600, 700)) +
  # -------- keep axes but shrink them ------------------------------
  labs(x = "", y = "") 
#   theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +           # small font
#   theme(
#     panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "grey20", fill = NA, linewidth = .3),
#     axis.title      = element_text(size = 7),
#     axis.text       = element_text(size = 6),
#     panel.grid.minor= element_blank()
#   )



library(cowplot)

final_plot <- ggdraw(p_main) +
  draw_plot(
    p_inset,
    x      = 0.65,   # npc coordinates 0–1
    y      = 0.40,   # just below the legend
    width  = 0.28,
    height = 0.28
  )

ggsave("Figures/Fig2_IEF_piechart_inset.pdf",
       plot   = final_plot,
       width  = 7.09, height = 8.27, units = "in",
       device = cairo_pdf)

```




## Plot distribution of crop's N2OIEF

```{r distribution plot}

#  prepare data: drop missing emission-factors
df <- N2OIEF %>% 
  filter(!is.na(N2O.IEF))%>%
  mutate(LogIEF = log10(N2O.IEF)) %>%
  mutate(Crop = factor(Crop, levels = rev(sort(unique(Crop)))))

#Plot ridge plot
library(ggridges)
library(forcats)

p <- df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = LogIEF, y = Crop, fill = Pathway)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous("Log10 implied N2O emission factor") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    axis.title     = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text      = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text     = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text    = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title   = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position= "bottom"
  )


# after building your ggplot object `p`:
ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Fig1_IEF_ridgelines.pdf",
  plot     = p,
  # 2-column width = 180 mm → 180/25.4 ≈ 7.09 in
  width    = 7.09,  
  height   = 8.27,  # e.g. max 2-col height ~210 mm → 210/25.4 ≈ 8.27 in
  units    = "in",
  device   = cairo_pdf  # embeds fonts cleanly
)


```
